mapper.sql: id, create_user_id, create_user_name, create_time, update_user_id, update_user_name, update_time, version, is_deleted, shop_id, token, access_token , expired_time , app_client_id ,type,refresh_token,shopee_id
mapper.select: SELECT auth.*, info.extend_data AS extendData FROM shop_auth auth LEFT JOIN shop_info info ON auth.shop_id = info."id" and info.auth_status = 'already' WHERE auth.is_deleted = FALSE and info.is_deleted = FALSE and info.dict_platform = #{platformType}

SELECT auth.id, auth.create_user_id, auth.create_user_name, auth.create_time, auth.update_user_id, auth.update_user_name, auth.update_time, auth.version, auth.is_deleted, auth.shop_id, auth.token, auth.access_token, auth.app_client_id, auth.expires_in, auth.type, auth.refresh_token, auth.shopee_id, auth.token_expire_time, auth.refresh_status, auth.refresh_error_msg, info.dict_platform FROM shop_auth auth INNER JOIN shop_info info ON auth.shop_id = info."id" and info.auth_status = 'already' WHERE auth.is_deleted = FALSE and info.is_deleted = FALSE and now() >= auth.token_expire_time and auth.refresh_status = 0
